text_block_list.text:
It was breathtaking. Her running possessed 
a power so fierce it made the hearts of 
all who watched tremble...!

With the unending cheers behind her, 
Silence Suzuka came running over toward 
me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san! Man, you were sooooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you...! I had so much fun too...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As I kept running, the sounds around me 
faded away, and the rush of the wind and 
the thudding of my heartbeat grew louder 
and louder...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just like when I ran in my very first 
race—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—No, it was a much quieter, more beautiful 
place...!

Seeing her so unusually hyped up brought 
an involuntary smile to my face as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We're having a party in our room today! A 
"Suzuka-san's race was so much fun!" 
party!

—Suddenly, I noticed a figure standing at 
the entrance.

—The sheer ability she demonstrated in the 
Kinko Sho seemed to ignite the fighting 
spirit of the Umamusume far more than 
expected.
